intro.title: Build a complete estimate
intro.subtitle: From a blank bid to a client-ready PDF

outro.title: Win more bids, protect your margin

scenes.title: The Bids workspace
scenes.narration: Alright, let's build a real construction estimate in BuildWorkPro, from a blank bid all the way to a polished, client-ready PDF. This is the Bids workspace, where every estimate you've sent and every one you're still working on lives in one place. Let's start a brand new one.

scenes.title: Create a new bid
scenes.narration: Creating a bid is simple. I'll give it a name the whole team will recognize, like Downtown Office HVAC Retrofit. From here I can link the customer, set my submission due date, and choose how long the pricing stays valid. I'll hit save, and just like that the bid is live and ready to build out.

actions.comment: desktop save button appears when the form is dirty
redirect to /bids/{id} proves the bid was created

scenes.title: Build the estimate
scenes.narration: Now the fun part, the estimate itself. Instead of typing line items from scratch, I can pull straight from my product and assembly catalog. I'll search for a condensing unit, drop it in, give it a mark, and add it to the estimate. Watch it join the other lines, each one rolling up into the customer total at the top, so I always know exactly where the number stands.

caption.text: 2. Add line items from your catalog

actions.comment: search the catalog — default order varies per bid, so filter to be deterministic
picks the product into the Add Line form
Mark is the only required field; it enables Add Line

scenes.title: Break a line into material & labor
scenes.narration: Here's where BuildWorkPro really separates itself. Every line can break down into its own material, labor, and equipment costs, what we call sublines. I'll expand this line, and you can see the real cost behind the price. Your true cost and your sell price always stay perfectly in sync.

actions.comment: expand the first line (chevron) to reveal its cost items / sublines
scroll the material + labor breakdown into view
you can add more material/labor/equipment cost items

scenes.title: Distributed project costs
scenes.narration: Not every cost belongs to a single line. Things like mobilization, a dumpster, or a site supervisor touch the whole job. With project costs, I enter it once and BuildWorkPro distributes it intelligently across the entire estimate, so nothing gets left off, and your margins stay honest.

actions.comment: the rate that spreads across all lines

scenes.title: Dial in margin & overhead
scenes.narration: Speaking of margin, this is the Rates tab. This is where raw cost becomes a winning bid. I'll set my target margin, layer in overhead and commission, and the customer total updates instantly. No spreadsheets, no manual math, just dial in the number that wins the job and protects your profit.

scenes.title: Preview the client-ready PDF
scenes.narration: And when everything looks right, one click gives me a clean, professional proposal. This is exactly what your client sees, your branding, a clear scope, and a price they can trust. Download it, send it, and you're done. That's a full estimate, built start to finish, in just a few minutes.
